questions.question: Discuss how Liebig and Shelford law help in understanding organisms distribution. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss how Liebig and Shelford law help in understanding organisms distribution.
  • [U]/[CO1]
  • • Liebig’s Law of Minimum states that an organism’s distribution depends on the
  • scarcest environmental factor. (1mark)
  • • Shelford’s Law of Tolerance adds that organisms can survive only within certain
  • range of environmental conditions. (1 mark)
